cards.ex: So, when are you two planning to tie the knot?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, qachon turmush qurishni rejalashtiryapsizlar?
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurmoq, oila qurish. Odatda, nikoh marosimi haqida.

cards.ex: He's a really family-oriented guy; he always puts his kids first.
cards.exUz: U juda oilaparvar yigit; u har doim farzandlarini birinchi o'ringa qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Oila qadriyatlarini hurmat qiladigan va oilaga bog'langan.

cards.ex: I get along with my siblings really well.
cards.exUz: Men aka-ukalarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They're a close-knit family; they spend all their holidays together.
cards.exUz: Ular ahil oila; ular barcha bayramlarni birga o'tkazishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda yaqin va bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan oila.

cards.ex: Sometimes, couples just grow apart over time.
cards.exUz: Ba'zida er-xotinlar vaqt o'tishi bilan shunchaki uzoqlashib ketishadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan munosabatlar susayishi, bir-biridan uzoqlashish.

cards.ex: They had a big fight, but they managed to patch things up.
cards.exUz: Ular qattiq janjallashishdi, lekin ular yarasha olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq janjaldan keyin munosabatlarni tiklash.

cards.ex: I heard their marriage is on the rocks.
cards.exUz: Eshitishimcha, ularning nikohi yomonlashgan.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarning qiyin ahvolda ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: We've been through thick and thin together.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma sinovlardan birga o'tdik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin va yaxshi kunlarda birga bo'lish.

cards.ex: Those two are like two peas in a pod.
cards.exUz: U ikkalasi ikki tomchi suvga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda o'xshash odamlar haqida aytiladi.

cards.ex: I know he's done some bad things, but blood is thicker than water.
cards.exUz: Bilaman, u ba'zi yomon ishlarni qildi, lekin qon qondan quyuq.
cards.uzDef: Oila munosabatlari boshqalardan muhimroq.

cards.ex: We spent the holiday with our extended family.
cards.exUz: Biz bayramni keng oilamiz bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Ota-ona, aka-uka, opa-singillar, buvi, bobo va boshqa qarindoshlar.

cards.ex: The nuclear family is still the most common family structure.
cards.exUz: Kichik oila hali ham eng keng tarqalgan oila tuzilmasidir.
cards.uzDef: Ota-ona va ularning farzandlaridan iborat oila.

cards.ex: They're planning to start a family soon.
cards.exUz: Ular yaqinda oila qurishni rejalashtiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Farzandli bo'lish va oilani tashkil qilish.

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older brother.
cards.exUz: Men har doim akamni hurmat qilganman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hurmat qilish va ulardan o'rnak olish.

cards.ex: She takes after her mother in terms of personality.
cards.exUz: U xarakteri jihatidan onasiga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zosiga tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xarakteri bilan o'xshash bo'lish.

cards.ex: We try to keep in touch despite living far apart.
cards.exUz: Biz uzoqda yashasak ham, aloqada bo'lishga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Doimo xabar olib turish, aloqani uzmaslik.

cards.ex: We were best friends in high school, but we drifted apart after graduation.
cards.exUz: Biz o'rta maktabda eng yaxshi do'st edik, lekin bitirgandan keyin uzoqlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlik yoki munosabat asta-sekin so'nishi.

cards.ex: He tried to make amends for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatolarini tuzatishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilgandan so'ng, vaziyatni o'nglashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm not ready to settle down yet.
cards.exUz: Men hali tinchlanishga tayyor emasman.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurish va doimiy joyda yashash.

cards.ex: It was love at first sight when they met.
cards.exUz: Ular uchrashganda bir ko'rishda sevgi edi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi ko'rishda sevgi hissi paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: They are head over heels in love.
cards.exUz: Ular bir-birini eshakdek sevishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda kuchli sevish.

cards.ex: He's planning to pop the question on their anniversary.
cards.exUz: U yubileylarida turmush qurishni taklif qilishni rejalashtiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurishni taklif qilish.

cards.ex: You can't just walk out on your family!
cards.exUz: Siz shunchaki oilangizni tashlab keta olmaysiz!
cards.uzDef: Birovni, ayniqsa, og'ir vaziyatda tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: I don't want to tie myself down just yet.
cards.exUz: Men hozircha o'zimni bog'lamoqchi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Birovning erkinligini cheklash, ko'pincha nikoh orqali.

cards.ex: Everyone knows she wears the pants in that relationship.
cards.exUz: Hamma biladi, u o'sha munosabatda hukmronlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oilada yoki munosabatlarda hukmronlik qilish.

cards.ex: She's a total daddy's girl.
cards.exUz: U butunlay dadajonisi.
cards.uzDef: Otasi bilan juda yaqin bo'lgan qiz.

cards.ex: He's a talented musician, like father, like son.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli musiqachi, otasi bolasiga o'xshab.
cards.uzDef: Ota va o'g'il o'xshash xususiyatlarga ega.

cards.ex: His granddaughter is the apple of his eye.
cards.exUz: Uning nabirasi uning ko'z qorachig'i.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir juda sevgan va qadrlaydigan odami.

cards.ex: They're birds of a feather, always hanging out together.
cards.exUz: Ular bir xil qushlar, doimo birga yurishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash odamlar birga bo'lishadi.

cards.ex: He hopes his son will carry on the family business.
cards.exUz: U o'g'li oilaviy biznesni davom ettirishiga umid qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oilaviy nomni yoki biznesni davom ettirish.
